Comment: Rebuild gold after any source_pipeline execution succeeds (EventBridge rule), or on demand. The job runs compute -> data quality checks -> write, so a failing check fails this execution before anything is published, and the alert says which check.

Retry.Comment: Two sources finishing together start two rebuilds; the job allows one run at a time, so the second waits and retries. A failed run (e.g. a data quality check) isn't retried: it would fail the same way

Parameters.Subject: weather-lakehouse: gold_pipeline failed
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Execution {} failed, nothing was published. Error: {} -- Cause: {}', $$.Execution.Name, $.error.Error, $.error.Cause)
